description: Proves the user owns the TikTok or YouTube account they post clips from, so its posts can be submitted to clipping campaigns hosted on heistclips (submit_clip). The first call returns a short code (hc-…); the user puts it anywhere in their TikTok bio or YouTube channel description and saves; the second call with the same arguments reads the public profile and confirms. The very first call (no account) returns a heistclips account code (hc_…) that later calls carry. Answers 'verify my TikTok', 'link my YouTube channel', 'how do I get paid for clips on heistclips'. Never asks for a password and never posts anything.

account.description: The heistclips account code (hc_…) from an earlier call. Leave out on the very first call.

handle.description: The account: TikTok @name or profile link; YouTube @handle, channel link or UC… channel id

name: verify_account
title: Verify my TikTok or YouTube account for campaigns hosted on heistclips
